headword: {葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}

definitions.explanation: An Edo-period painter and woodblock-print artist, best known for the series {富嶽三十六景|ふがくさんじゅうろっけい} (Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji), which includes The Great Wave off Kanagawa. His work strongly influenced European painters of the nineteenth century.

examples.japanese: {葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{浮世絵師|うきよえし}だ。
examples.english: Katsushika Hokusai was an ukiyo-e artist.

examples.japanese: {葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Hokusai's picture of the wave is known all over the world.

examples.japanese: {葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九十歳|きゅうじゅっさい}{近|ちか}くまで⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{描|か}き、⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{何十回|なんじゅっかい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Hokusai kept painting until nearly ninety and is said to have moved house dozens of times in his life.

notes:
Usually called {北斎|ほくさい}. The Great Wave print, {神奈川沖浪裏|かながわおきなみうら}, appears on the new 1,000-yen note issued in 2024 and in the design of Japanese passports.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {富嶽三十六景|ふがくさんじゅうろっけい}: Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji
- {北斎|ほくさい}⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧: Hokusai's sketchbooks of people, animals, and daily life

CULTURAL NOTE:
His prints reached Europe in the nineteenth century and fed the fashion for Japanese art known as Japonisme, influencing Monet, Van Gogh, and Debussy.
